_doc: Thresholds for validation, conversion, segmentation and features. Speeds are physical px per ms, times are ms.
_motion_speed_doc: Event-rate and gap checks only use intervals where the cursor moves at least this fast (px/ms): slower than about 1 px per poll the mouse legitimately skips reports.
_timeline_clock_doc: Which timestamps build the 1 ms timelines: t_grid (snapped to the polling grid), raw (as the browser delivered them), or auto (per session, whichever gives the lower speed noise).
